facts.fact: The e-Government Division of the SMART Zambia Institute deployed high-speed internet, with telepresence systems, computers and solar power, at Sinazongwe Town Council in Southern Province, as part of the Government Wide Area Network initiative; no event date is given, so the published date of 26 August 2026 is used.

The connection at Sinazongwe Town Council is expected to let council staff process documents, join virtual meetings and communicate with central government and other local authorities; no national system worked in is named, and no event date is given, so the published date is used.

One council, Sinazongwe Town Council, is reported as given high-speed internet under the Government Wide Area Network initiative, which the article says seeks to connect all 116 councils; no count of councils already connected is given, and the date is the published date.
The deployment at Sinazongwe Town Council was made by the e-Government Division of the SMART Zambia Institute, a state body; the date is the published date.

The article describes the Government Wide Area Network initiative as seeking to connect all 116 councils and government institutions to a secure high-speed backbone; it names no plan document, cost or completion date, and the date is the published date.

Sinazongwe Town Council received high-speed internet, telepresence systems, desktops, laptops and solar power from the SMART Zambia Institute, reported on 26 August 2026 with training of local ICT staff under way.
